title: 📝 Block 2 Revision
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 revision booklet worksheets (with model answers) + TEST-1

scenes.t: Are you ready for the Block 2 exam, Yahia? Let's revise everything together!
First, read the words slowly. Then, send each word to its family.
In word completion, read the description and remember the first letter.
In jumbled sentences, start with the capital letter and end with a full stop or question mark.
Take your time, read carefully, and you will do great!

activities.title: Classify the Words
activities.prompt: Catch each word and send it to its family!

activities.title: Jobs Match
activities.prompt: Match each job with what the person does.
pairs: He flies planes and takes people to different places.
He puts out fires and helps people in danger.
She helps sick people and gives them medicine.

Put in order: loudly - playground - children - the - in - play - the
o: The children play loudly in the playground.
The children loudly play in the playground.
The playground children play loudly in the.

items.q: Put in order: don't - go - on - we - Friday - school - to
o: We don't go to school on Friday.
We don't go on Friday to school.
On Friday we don't to school go.

items.q: Put in order: has - got - curly - brown - he - hair
o: He has got curly brown hair.
He has got brown curly hair.
Curly brown hair he has got.

items.q: Put in order: be - wants - a - she - doctor - to
o: She wants to be a doctor.
She wants to doctor be a.
A doctor she wants be to.

items.q: Put in order: answered - that - quickly - Salem - question
o: Salem quickly answered that question is.
That question Salem answered quickly is.

items.q: Put in order: hospital - a - where - place - mustn't - the - you - shout - is
o: A hospital is the place where you mustn't shout.
A hospital is where the place you mustn't shout.
The hospital a place is where you mustn't shout.
